description: Fetch the full content of one prompt by name, title, id or short-id. Optionally pin an exact version number. Returns the prompt text plus the {{variable}} names it expects — if there are variables, either fill them yourself or call fill_variables.

name.description: Prompt title, id, or unique title fragment

project.description: Repo name, slug, or id to scope resolution when titles collide

version.description: Exact version number to fetch (default: current)

via.description: Set 'suggestion' when fetching a prompt that suggest_prompts or a PromptLikeEngineer hint offered

name: get_prompt
title: Get prompt content
